markdown-docx 0.2.0 syntax

Supported Markdown:
  ATX headings, paragraphs, emphasis, strong text, inline code, hard line breaks, fenced code blocks, blockquotes, ordered and unordered lists, pipe tables, and images.

Metadata comments:
  document metadata must be first
  section metadata starts a next-page section
  <!-- markdown-docx: page-break --> inserts a page break
  table metadata must immediately precede a pipe table
  image metadata must immediately precede a standalone image

Lengths use in, cm, mm, or pt. Image widths may also use percentages.

Unsupported in 0.2.0:
  links, raw HTML, task lists, footnotes, horizontal rules, indented code blocks, multi-paragraph list items, DOTX, floating images, headers and footers from Markdown, page-number fields, and direct OOXML features.
